output.summary: A creeping perennial herb endemic to the Iberian Peninsula, Biarum mendax is restricted to the southwest and, in Portugal, to inland Alentejo. It grows on basic, non-calcareous soils along road embankments and traditional rain-fed olive groves. A 2020 mainland Portugal assessment, based on work in 2016–2019, classified it as Endangered amid continuing population and habitat decline.
